notDance.heading: Zeybek is not just a dance
notDance.subheading: A posture. A character. A culture.
notDance.body1: For us, zeybek is not just a dance consisting of a few figures. What makes it special is its unique manner, posture, music, movements, and the cultural heritage it carries.
notDance.body2: In our lessons, while learning traditional figures correctly, we also discover the posture of zeybek and the culture behind it. Because dancing zeybek well is not just knowing the steps, but being able to understand the character of zeybek.

story.heading: Our Story
story.quote:
Zeybek has always been part of my life. Being from Aydın, zeybek was a natural part of my life from childhood. Seeing and hearing zeybek at weddings, parks, special events – even sometimes at the market – was an ordinary thing in everyday life.

I have been professionally learning and dancing zeybek since 2017. I started teaching in 2020. After moving to Amsterdam in 2022, I asked myself: 'Why shouldn't I dance zeybek here too, why shouldn't I teach it?'

I started giving the first zeybek lessons in Amsterdam in 2023. Zeybek Academy emerged as the natural continuation of this process.

The aim is actually very simple: I love dancing zeybek very much. I want to teach it to people who want to learn and dance together with everyone.

Because for me, zeybek is much more than a dance. A posture, a personality, a character.

hub.heading: Ready to discover zeybek?
hub.body: Zeybek is a powerful tradition combining dance, music, posture, manner, and cultural memory. In this section, you can discover what zeybek is, its history, culture, dance, and its characters in different regions.

what.title: What is Zeybek?
what.body1: Zeybek is a traditional folk dance and cultural tradition strongly associated with Western Anatolia and Aegean culture.
what.body2: Zeybek is not limited to a single dance or single sequence of figures. It exists in various forms in different regions, different dances, and different musical characters.
what.body3: At Zeybek Academy, we approach zeybek not just as figures, but together with the dance's manner, posture, music, and cultural background.

history.title: History of Zeybek
history.body1: The history of zeybek is a multi-layered subject intertwined with the social and cultural history of Western Anatolia.
history.body2: How the concept of zeybek was used throughout history, the social position of zeybek practitioners, and how zeybek culture transformed over time have been addressed in different ways in different sources.
history.body3: For this reason, rather than presenting a single story as absolute truth, we aim to convey the historical development of zeybek in an understandable way by drawing on reliable historical sources.

culture.title: Zeybek Culture
culture.body1: Zeybek culture is not just about dancing.
culture.body2: Music, costume, posture, manner, regional narratives, collective memory, and the stories carried by the dances make up different parts of zeybek culture.
culture.body3: For us, keeping the culture alive does not mean freezing the past as it is; it means being able to pass traditional knowledge correctly to new generations and people outside Turkiye.
culture.approachBody: While teaching figures in lessons, alongside 'How is this movement done?' we also care about 'What is the character of this movement, how is it danced, and what cultural context does it come from?'

dance.title: Zeybek Dance
dance.body1: Zeybek dance is a powerful form of expression with its unique posture, arm and body use, steps, rhythmic structure, and dance characters.
dance.body2: Understanding the manner, the relationship with music, and body control is as important as learning the figures correctly.
dance.body3: At Zeybek Academy, female and male students can dance the male zeybeks in our repertoire together.
approachItems: Understanding the character of the dance

posture.title: Zeybek Posture
posture.body1: Zeybek posture is one of the most distinctive elements of the dance.
posture.body2: Posture is not just the shape the body takes. It is a form of expression that carries the character, confidence, and manner of zeybek.
posture.body3: In our lessons, alongside doing a figure correctly, we aim to be able to carry that figure in a way appropriate to the character of zeybek.
posture.body4: We believe that the development of body awareness and control while learning zeybek can also contribute to students' posture in daily life.

music.title: Zeybek Music
music.body1: One of the important ways to understand zeybek dances is to understand their music.
music.body2: The rhythm, tempo, melody, and the relationship of instruments with the character of the dance affect how the dance will be felt and danced.
music.body3: This section will be expanded over time with content introducing the musical characters, rhythms, and regional characteristics of different zeybek dances.

dances.title: Zeybek Dances & Regions
dances.body2: Tempo, figures, manner, music, and performance styles can vary in different regions and dances. These differences are an important part of the richness of zeybek culture.
dances.body3: In this section, we will introduce the dances in our repertoire together with their region, character, and brief story as much as possible.

repertoire.title: Our Repertoire
repertoire.body: One of the strongest features of Zeybek Academy is its extensive and growing repertoire. We aim to present the dances in our repertoire not just by name, but with their region, character, level, and video examples where possible.
repertoire.comingSoon: The full repertoire list will be added soon.

whoWeAre.heading: Who are we?
whoWeAre.body1: Zeybek Academy is a zeybek academy operating in Amsterdam with the aim of keeping zeybek culture alive and teaching it correctly.
whoWeAre.body2: Our educational approach is based on sharing zeybek's manner, posture, music, culture, and story beyond just the figures.

story.heading: Our Founding Story
story.body1: Zeybek has always been part of my life. Being from Aydın, I grew up intertwined with zeybek since childhood.
story.body2: In 2017, I started professionally learning and dancing zeybek. I started teaching in 2020. When I moved to Amsterdam in 2022, the idea of dancing and teaching zeybek here too was born. I started the first lessons in 2023.
story.body3: Zeybek Academy is the natural continuation of this journey and love of zeybek.

why.heading: Why our own academy?
why.body: Because we love dancing zeybek very much and we want to share it with people who want to learn and dance together with everyone.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: To contribute to the correct, respectful, and powerful recognition of zeybek culture outside Turkiye and to try to bring zeybek dance to the place it deserves internationally.

level.heading: Lesson Level
level.body: We currently don't have separate groups for beginner, intermediate, and advanced. Everyone learns new dances together and lessons progress at an intermediate level.

beginners.heading: Beginners
